cues.zh: 时值十一月底，
cues.en: As we reach the end of November,

cues.zh: 我们很多人都会拿出装饰品，哼着小曲儿忙活起来。
cues.en: many of us get out the decorations and fa la la la la and whatnot.

cues.zh: 我也毫不例外，尤其是在灯光这件事上。
cues.en: I’m certainly no exception, especially when it comes to lighting.

cues.zh: 为什么一到圣诞节我们就要在家里到处挂满灯泡呢？
cues.en: Why exactly do we litter our homes with light bulbs ‘round Christmas time?

cues.zh: 不知道，但多半是营销的功劳。
cues.en: Don’t know, but it’s probably marketing.

cues.zh: 不过老天，这招对我还真管用，
cues.en: By golly it worked on me, though,

cues.zh: 而作为一个灯光爱好者，能把成百上千个小灯泡
cues.en: and as a lighting enthusiast generally the opportunity to put hundreds of little light bulbs

cues.zh: 挂到栏杆、窗户、灌木、树木等各处，这机会实在没法错过。
cues.en: on railings and windows and shrubs and trees and stuff is just impossible to pass up.

cues.zh: 但你可能也知道，我对圣诞灯饰行业有个意见。
cues.en: But as you may very well know, I have a problem with the Christmas lighting industry.

cues.zh: 这个意见就是LED灯。
cues.en: And that problem is LEDs.

cues.zh: 别误会，我很喜欢LED！
cues.en: Don’t get me wrong, I love LEDs!

cues.zh: 发光二极管是近年来最重要的发明之一。
cues.en: The light emitting diode is one of the most important inventions of the last however many years.

cues.zh: 有些 LED 圣诞灯确实很棒！
cues.en: And some LED Christmas lights are great!

cues.zh: 但多彩的 LED 圣诞灯通常不怎么样。
cues.en: But multi-colored LED Christmas lights usually aren’t.

cues.zh: 它们看起来不够喜庆、欢快、明亮，
cues.en: Rather than look festive and cheery and bright,

cues.zh: 现代 LED 圣诞灯通常倒像是有台游戏电脑在你家前院爆炸了。
cues.en: modern LED Christmas light sets usually make it look like a gaming PC exploded on your front lawn.

cues.zh: 如果你就喜欢这种风格，
cues.en: If that aesthetic tickles your fancy,

cues.zh: 我会评判你，但不会妨碍你。
cues.en: I will judge you but I won’t get in your way.

cues.zh: 玩得开心。
cues.en: Have fun.

cues.zh: 过去几年里，我一直执着地寻找一种方法，让现代 LED 圣诞灯
cues.en: But for the past several years I have been on a foolish quest to determine the best way to make modern LED Christmas lights

cues.zh: 看起来像老式白炽圣诞灯。
cues.en: look like old-fashioned incandescent Christmas lights.

cues.zh: 幸好，一群比我投入得多的人创办了 Tru-Tone，
cues.en: Luckily, some much-more-commited-than-me folks started up Tru-Tone

cues.zh: 现在生产非常出色的 C7 和 C9 LED 灯泡。
cues.en: and now manufacture incredibly excellent LED versions of C7 and C9 bulbs.

cues.zh: 它们几乎和那些耗电的白炽灯泡一模一样，
cues.en: They are virtually indistinguishable from their energy-sucking incandescent counterparts

cues.zh: 如果这正是你想要的，可以去看看。
cues.en: and if that’s something you’re looking for, you should check them out.

cues.zh: 他们没付钱让我这么说，这些东西是我自己掏钱买的
cues.en: They’re not paying me to say that, I bought these with my own money

cues.zh: 但这正是我一直希望有人能做出来的东西
cues.en: but they are exactly what I’ve been hoping somebody would do

cues.zh: 如果你住在北美（而且跟我一样是个怪咖），我想你会对它们非常满意。
cues.en: and if you live in North America (and are the same kind of weirdo I am) I think you’ll be more than pleased with them.

cues.zh: 不过，Tru-Tone 还没能在解决迷你灯泡问题上取得进展。
cues.en: However, Tru-Tone has not yet made inroads on tackling the mini-light problem.

cues.zh: 所以又来了。
cues.en: So here we go again.

cues.zh: 为了解释我的问题是什么，
cues.en: To explain what my problem is,

cues.zh: 在过去，我们靠把微小的钨丝烧得非常非常热来发光。
cues.en: in ye-olden days we made light happen by making tiny bits of tungsten wire very very hot.

cues.zh: 高温物体会通过白炽效应发光，
cues.en: Hot things produce light through incandescence,

cues.zh: 当温度足够高时，会发射出一大堆波长的光，合在一起看起来就是白色。
cues.en: and when it’s hot enough a whole bunch of wavelengths of light will be emitted which together look white.

cues.zh: 当我们想让那看起来是白色以外的颜色时，
cues.en: When we wanted to make that look a color other-than-white,

cues.zh: 我们会在灯泡玻璃上加一层涂层，用来滤掉大部分波长，只留下目标颜色。
cues.en: we’d add a coating to the glass of the light bulb which acted to filter out most wavelengths aside from our target color.

cues.zh: 最终混合出了各种波长的光，呈现出一种讨喜的效果（虽然亮度有所降低）。
cues.en: The result was a sort of blend of wavelengths that produced a pleasing (if reduced in brightness) appearance.

cues.zh: 而 LED 则不同，它只发射单一波长的光，
cues.en: LEDs, on the other hand, only emit a single wavelength of light

cues.zh: 这取决于制造它所用的材料。
cues.en: which depends on the materials used to create it.

cues.zh: 这种单色光的色彩饱和度极高，因为它纯粹到了极致——
cues.en: That monochromatic light has an incredibly intense color because it is literally pure as can be -

cues.zh: 就像修图软件里的色轮取色器一样。
cues.en: it’s like the color wheel picker on your image editing app.

cues.zh: 一种绝对纯净的色调。
cues.en: A perfectly pure hue.

cues.zh: 你们中有些人可能会喜欢这种效果。
cues.en: Some of you may like this.

cues.zh: 有时连我自己也挺喜欢的。
cues.en: Even I like it at times.

cues.zh: 但用在圣诞彩灯上？
cues.en: But for Christmas lights?

cues.zh: 感觉就完全不对了。
cues.en: It’s just wrong.

cues.zh: 尤其是绿色和蓝色——那根本没有温馨治愈的节日氛围，
cues.en: Especially greens and blues - that is not a warm and fuzzy looking festive display,

cues.zh: 反而像那种俗气的小店，窗边围着一圈跑马灯 LED 灯带，提醒你他们店里卖 CBD 精油。
cues.en: it’s a tacky storefront with those chasing LED strips around the windows letting you know they have CBD oil.

cues.zh: 抱歉，但事实就是这样！
cues.en: I’m sorry, that’s just the truth!

cues.zh: 如果把蓝色和绿色稍微调暗一点，
cues.en: If the blue and the green could be toned down a bit,

cues.zh: 我可能就不会这么暴躁了。
cues.en: I’d probably be a little less grumpy about this.

cues.zh: 彩色 LED 灯串和彩色白炽灯串看起来之所以差异如此巨大，
cues.en: A large part of why LED multicolored sets and incandescent multi-colored sets look so starkly different

cues.zh: 很大程度上是因为白炽灯的灯丝并不会产生太多的绿光到蓝光波段
cues.en: is that the filament in an incandescent light doesn’t produce a whole lot of the green-to-blue wavelengths

cues.zh: （那需要把钨丝加热到接近熔化的温度，灯泡根本用不了多久）。
cues.en: (that would require getting tungsten into melty temperatures and those bulbs wouldn’t last long at all).

cues.zh: 所以，纯粹由于物理原因，蓝色和绿色看起来会比红色、橙色，尤其是黄色要暗得多。
cues.en: So, through pure physics reasons the blue and green will appear quite a lot darker than reds, oranges, and especially yellows.

cues.zh: 如果有一款彩色 LED 灯串能模拟出这种相对亮度比例，那体验绝对会好得多。
cues.en: A multi-colored LED set that just mimicked those relative brightness ratios would be a huge improvement.

cues.zh: 不过，要做到这一点确实有客观难度。
cues.en: There are reasons that’s difficult, though.

cues.zh: 大概就是压降、氮化镓之类的各种技术限制。
cues.en: Something something voltage drop, gallium nitride, et cetera.

cues.zh: 但还有另一种办法：
cues.en: But there’s another way:

cues.zh: 通过大量创新，用蓝色到近紫外二极管激发荧光粉涂层，
cues.en: through lots of innovation involving phosphor coatings excited by blue to near-UV diodes,

cues.zh: 我们造出了非常好、带宽相当宽、而且相当便宜的白光LED。
cues.en: we’ve made extremely good and reasonably broad-band white LEDs that are quite cheap.

cues.zh: 那为什么不干脆做一大堆白色二极管，然后像我们过去那样，给它们套上彩色灯罩呢？
cues.en: So, why don’t we just make a whole bunch of white diodes and put a colored cap over them a la the way we used to do it?

cues.zh: 这样就能两全其美了！
cues.en: Then we could have the best of both worlds!

cues.zh: 先确认一下这事还没发生，顺便说一句，
cues.en: Just to make sure that hasn’t happened yet and, side note,

cues.zh: 哪位行行好把它做了吧，我好收尾！
cues.en: somebody please just do it so I can end this!

cues.zh: 我去了几家大型连锁店，看看他们的大卖场里都卖些什么。
cues.en: I went to a couple of big box stores to see what their big boxes had in store.

cues.zh: 首先值得注意的是：
cues.en: The first thing of note:

cues.zh: 欧洲在入侵！
cues.en: Europe is invading!

cues.zh: 传统上，这边的灯串直接通着未经处理的市电电压。
cues.en: Traditionally, light sets over here just have raw mains voltage going through them.

cues.zh: 一串100颗的小灯，实际上是两段各50颗灯泡串联起来的。
cues.en: A set of 100 mini-lights will actually have two runs of 50 bulbs wired in series.

cues.zh: 灯泡的额定电压大约是 2.5 伏，全部串联起来总计就是 125 伏
cues.en: The bulbs are rated for somewhere near 2.5 volts and with them all in series that adds up to 125 volts

cues.zh: （其实灯泡坏掉时会短路，这样整串灯的其他部分还能继续亮……
cues.en: (the bulbs actually fail as a short circuit which keeps the rest of the strand lit…

cues.zh: 通常是这样……所以他们为此预留了一些冗余）。
cues.en: usually… so they build some margin in for that).

cues.zh: C9 和 C7 灯串则是直接给每个灯座提供市电电压，顺便科普个冷知识，
cues.en: C9 and C7 sets supply straight line voltage to each bulb socket which, fun fact,

cues.zh: 这就是为什么那些灯串用的是极性插头，而微型灯串不用。
cues.en: is why those sets have polarized plugs and mini-light sets don’t.

cues.zh: 这是给剪辑师自己的备忘：一定要打个星号备注一下，有些较老的 C7 和 C9 灯串其实也是串联的。
cues.en: This is a note to editor me, make sure you put that little asterisk in there about how some older C7 and C9 sets were also in series.

cues.zh: 加上了吗？
cues.en: Did you do it?

cues.zh: 很好！
cues.en: Good!

cues.zh: 不过现在，配有小型电源适配器、能输出某种非市电电压的 LED 灯串也开始普及了。
cues.en: Now, though, LED light strands that come with little power adapters that make some flavor of not-line-voltage are starting to become available.

cues.zh: 而且还有了全新的外观形态！
cues.en: And new form factors, too!

cues.zh: 大多数 LED 灯串一直在模仿白炽灯的外形，但现在我们有了所谓的“米粒灯”——
cues.en: Most LED sets have been mimicking the shape of incandescent lights but now we have so-called “rice lights” -

cues.zh: 它们还内置了一些跑马灯功能，显得更有意思。
cues.en: and these have some built-in chasing functions to make things interesting.

cues.zh: 还有这些“带状灯”，看起来像是LED灯带的变体，但二极管都做成了小团块状。
cues.en: And then there’s these “ribbon lights” which seem to be a play on LED tape light but with diodes in little blobs.

cues.zh: 这两种都挺有意思的，
cues.en: Both of these are intriguing,

cues.zh: 不过我不得不说，那带状灯看起来不太耐用，
cues.en: though I must say that ribbon light doesn’t look too durable,

cues.zh: 但遗憾的是，多色套装看起来还是像独角兽吐出来的东西，所以我只好放弃了。
cues.en: but sadly the multi-colored sets still look like something a unicorn threw up so I had to pass.

cues.zh: 还有一点挺有意思，市面上一些“传统”LED灯串开始采用不可更换的灯泡了。
cues.en: Also interesting, some of the “traditional” LED sets for sale are starting to come with non-replaceable bulbs.

cues.zh: 说实话，一开始这让我挺恼火的。
cues.en: To be honest, this annoyed me at first.

cues.zh: 但后来我觉得这可能是件好事。
cues.en: But I’ve come around to this probably being better.

cues.zh: 直到今年，我见过的每一套这类灯串，从技术上讲，灯泡都是可更换的，
cues.en: Until this year, every one of these sets I’ve seen has technically had replaceable bulbs

cues.zh: 但它们的做法和过去的白炽灯串一模一样。
cues.en: but they were made just like the incandescent sets of the past.

cues.zh: 事实上，常常是LED的引脚像过去迷你白炽灯那细细的导线一样，弯折卡在灯座上。
cues.en: In fact, it was often the legs of the LED bent around the bulb holder just like the tiny wire leads of the incandescent mini-lights.

cues.zh: 那里腐蚀是个大问题，而且灯泡有时会掉出来，导致整串灯都坏掉，
cues.en: Corrosion was a major problem there, plus the bulbs could sometimes end up falling out which would kill the whole strand,

cues.zh: 所以把整串密封起来，长期来看可能会让灯串更耐用。
cues.en: so sealing the whole thing up is likely going to make the set more durable in the long-run.

cues.zh: 可惜，说到颜色，
cues.en: Alas, when it came to the colors,

cues.zh: 要么是“还算不错的暖白光”，要么是“亮瞎眼的多彩色”，
cues.en: everything was either “decent warm white” or “shield your eyes multi-colored”

cues.zh: 所以又该碰碰运气，看看怎么让这些灯不那么糟糕了。
cues.en: so it’s time yet again to try my luck at figuring out how to make these less awful.

cues.zh: 以下是我过去尝试过的方法总结。
cues.en: Here’s a summary of things I’ve tried in the past.

cues.zh: Sharpie 记号笔：效果很好，但很快在日晒和/或雨淋下褪色。
cues.en: Sharpies: worked great but quickly faded in the sun and/or rain.

cues.zh: 喷漆：完全没用。
cues.en: Spray paint: didn’t work at all.

cues.zh: 丙烯手工颜料：完全没用。
cues.en: Acrylic craft paint: didn’t work at all.

cues.zh: 透明丙烯手工颜料：效果出奇地好！
cues.en: Transparent acrylic craft paint: worked surprisingly well!

cues.zh: 不过耐用性测试没做，因为我忘了。
cues.en: Durability testing didn’t happen, though, because I forgot.

cues.zh: 指甲油：又一个意外惊喜！
cues.en: Nail polish: another surprise hit!

cues.zh: 大概是最简单的一种，耐用性应该还行，但同样没做实际测试，因为我忘了。
cues.en: Probably the easiest of all and durability was probably decent but again actual testing didn’t happen because I forgot.

cues.zh: 不过目前我只试了这些。
cues.en: But that’s all I’ve tried so far.

cues.zh: 至少我是这么想的。
cues.en: At least I think.

cues.zh: 等等——我忘了Rit染料：
cues.en: Wait - I forgot about the Rit dye:

cues.zh: 那个也没成功。
cues.en: That also didn’t work.

cues.zh: 染色过程的高温还把灯烤得弯弯曲曲的。
cues.en: The heat from the dying process made the lights get all bendy, too.

cues.zh: 肯定还有更好的办法。
cues.en: Surely there’s something better out there.

cues.zh: 为了让你看得开心，也为了排解我的无聊，
cues.en: And for your viewing pleasure and my sense of ennui,

cues.zh: 又到了测试灯泡上色技巧的时间了。
cues.en: it’s time to once again test some light bulb painting techniques.

cues.zh: 今天的日程是环氧树脂和配套的染料，
cues.en: On the docket today are epoxy resin and dyes for said epoxy resin,

cues.zh: 然后是一种改良版的丙烯手工颜料，加了水和胶水，
cues.en: then we have a twist on acrylic craft paint involving some water and glue,

cues.zh: 最后还有神秘的第三样东西。
cues.en: and finally we have a mystery third thing.

cues.zh: 敬请期待。效果相当不错！
cues.en: Stay tuned for that one. It worked pretty good!

cues.zh: 今年我搞的第一波折腾，是环氧树脂。
cues.en: I started this year’s shenanigans with epoxy resin.

cues.zh: 我订了一些树脂和染料，心想“这也许能行”。
cues.en: I ordered some and some dyes for it and thought “this might work OK.”

cues.zh: 但想法和实验不是一回事，
cues.en: But a thought is not the same as an experiment,

cues.zh: 而我没空间做思想实验。
cues.en: and I don’t have room for thought experiments.

cues.zh: 总之我调了一些，加了点染料，然后祈祷结果不错。
cues.en: Anyway so I mixed some up, added some dye to it, and hoped for the best.

cues.zh: 我从蓝色开始，因为这是最棘手的颜色——我想要漂亮的深蓝，所以染料得放挺多。
cues.en: I started with blue because this is the trickiest color - I want a nice deep blue, so it needs to have quite a lot of dye.

cues.zh: 但放太多可能就变黑了。
cues.en: But go too far and it might be black.

cues.zh: 结果在这儿根本不是问题。
cues.en: Turns out that wasn’t a problem here.

cues.zh: 尽管往树脂里加了不少染料，但在我早就知道需要的那层薄薄的罩面涂层里，混合物几乎没上什么色。
cues.en: Despite adding quite a lot of dye to the resin, the mixture added hardly any color in the thin skim-coating that I knew I’d need.

cues.zh: 这点我得提一下——
cues.en: And this is something that I need to touch on -

cues.zh: 在我这里的所有尝试中，大家（很热心地）建议我该试试这个那个
cues.en: in all my attempts here, people are (quite helpfully) suggesting things I should try

cues.zh: 但我收到的很多建议，结果颜色浓度远远达不到我需要的程度。
cues.en: but a lot of the suggestions I’ve received turn out to have nowhere near as much color as I need.

cues.zh: 彩色玻璃漆或彩色热缩管都不够暗——
cues.en: Things like stained glass paint or colored heat shrink tubing just aren’t dark enough -

cues.zh: 未点亮的白炽灯玻璃，除了黄色或琥珀色，其他颜色看起来都近乎黑色。
cues.en: the glass of an unlit incandescent set looks nearly black on all colors but yellow or amber.

cues.zh: 所以如果想成功，我需要多得多的染料。
cues.en: So if this was gonna work, I’d need way more dye.

cues.zh: 加了多得多的染料之后，
cues.en: After adding way more dye,

cues.zh: 我开始担心染料太多，树脂会无法正常固化。
cues.en: I was starting to get worried that there would be too much dye for the resin to cure properly.

cues.zh: 但只有一种办法能验证。
cues.en: But there was only one way to find out.

cues.zh: 把混合物调得深到看起来发黑之后，起初看起来很有希望，但很快就适得其反。
cues.en: After making the concoction so dark as to appear black, things looked promising at first but then quickly became the opposite of that.

cues.zh: 试浸结果显示，这里的平衡有多难把握——太暗和不够暗之间——
cues.en: Test-dunks revealed just how tricky the balance is here between too dark and not dark enough -

cues.zh: 光线在短短片刻间就从几乎看不见，变成恰到好处，再变成太淡。
cues.en: the light goes from hardly visible to just right to too pale in a matter of moments.

cues.zh: 再加上要达到我想要的涂层厚度本身就很难
cues.en: Add to this the general difficulty of getting the coating thickness I wanted

cues.zh: （这种树脂流动性极强，即使等了一个多小时，虽然已经变稠了不少，最终还是会流掉）
cues.en: (this resin was extremely runny and even after waiting over an hour, despite thickening quite a bit, it would still run off eventually)

cues.zh: 于是环氧树脂被完全排除了。
cues.en: and epoxy was ruled out completely.

cues.zh: 我的下一招，是尝试纯凭运气偶然发现的乳白玻璃涂层。
cues.en: My next trick was to try the milk glass coating I stumbled upon through sheer dumb luck.

cues.zh: 我去年从那家“瑞典肉丸店”（宜家）买了这几盏台灯，虽然外观挺酷，
cues.en: I got these table lamps from the Swedish meatball place last year and while they are pretty cool looking,

cues.zh: 但余光里总晃着裸露的灯泡，感觉挺难受的，
cues.en: having bare light bulbs in your peripheral vision kind of sucks

cues.zh: 所以我想把玻璃做成磨砂的。
cues.en: so I wanted to frost the glass.

cues.zh: 但不是半透明的那种磨砂，而是不透明的纯白磨砂，
cues.en: But not frost it like the translucent kind of frosting, but the opaque white kind of frosting,

cues.zh: 网上又没啥好教程，我就试着用等重量的水、白色手工漆和白乳胶混合，
cues.en: and there weren’t any good guides on how to do this so I just tried equal parts (by weight) water, white craft paint, and PVA glue

cues.zh: 天哪，效果居然出奇地完美！
cues.en: and by golly it worked perfectly!

cues.zh: 台灯现在看着依然很棒，没开裂也没发黄，
cues.en: The lamps still look great, no cracking or yellowing,

cues.zh: 如果你想了解更多这个制作过程，可以去看看 Connextras 上的视频。
cues.en: and if you’re interested in learning more about this process you can check out the video on Connextras.

cues.zh: 我想把这个方法用在圣诞彩灯上，不过用的是彩色颜料，而不是纯白色。
cues.en: I thought I would try this technique for Christmas lights but using colored paint instead of just white.

cues.zh: 所以我调配了一些，把灯泡浸了进去，还以为自己搞定了！
cues.en: So I mixed some up, dunked the bulbs, and thought that perhaps I had cracked it!

cues.zh: 结果涂层开裂了。
cues.en: But then the coating cracked.

cues.zh: 唉，不确定是不是因为涂在塑料上的缘故，涂层收缩、开裂，整体根本附着不住。
cues.en: Yeah, not sure if it’s because it was on plastic or what but the coating shrank and cracked and generally didn’t hold up.

cues.zh: 我还试过只用一半胶水加一半颜料，
cues.en: I also tried just half glue and half paint

cues.zh: （加了水之后混合物有点太稀了，不太符合预期）
cues.en: (the water made the mixture a little runnier than I think I wanted)

cues.zh: 但这个干了之后效果也不行。
cues.en: but this also didn’t dry well.

cues.zh: 同样，我先拿蓝色试手，既然这两种方法都行不通，我就果断放弃了。
cues.en: Again, I started with blue and since both of those two techniques didn’t work I promptly gave up.

cues.zh: 就算这方法可行，它也是那种磨砂质感，虽然我也能接受，
cues.en: Even if this had worked well, it still had that frosted look which I would have accepted

cues.zh: 但终究不是我最想要的效果。
cues.en: but wasn’t exactly what I was going for.

cues.zh: 所以，只能推倒重来了。
cues.en: So, back to the drawing board.

cues.zh: 到目前为止，我做出的最好效果是用透明工艺漆做出来的。
cues.en: The absolute best end-result I have gotten so far came from transparent craft paint.

cues.zh: 但是，涂起来既麻烦又让人抓狂。
cues.en: But, it was fiddly and annoying to apply.

cues.zh: 说真的，客观来看，整件事本来就很离谱。
cues.en: I mean, let’s be real, this whole endeavor is objectively ridiculous.

cues.zh: 我就是这么个爱把烂梗玩到底的离谱人，但如果还要继续做下去，我希望能稍微轻松一点。
cues.en: I am a ridiculous person who is committed to the bit, but if I’m gonna keep doing this I want something just a little bit easier.

cues.zh: 不过后来我注意到，我手头的一瓶颜料——就是我身后架子上放了大概有两年之久的那瓶黄色颜料——
cues.en: But then I noticed that one of my bottles of paint - the yellow one that’s been sitting on the shelves behind me for what, two years now? -

cues.zh: 上面写着“喷笔专用色”。
cues.en: says “Airbrush colors” on it.

cues.zh: 讲真，我以前从来用不上喷笔（airbrush）
cues.en: Now, I’ve never had a need for an airbrush

cues.zh: （我平时都用梳子打理头发）
cues.en: (usually I use a comb)

cues.zh: 但既然颜料是专门为喷笔设计的，也许用喷笔会有用。
cues.en: but if that’s what it’s designed for maybe an airbrush would help.

cues.zh: 于是我就买了一个！
cues.en: So I got one!

cues.zh: 我是在亚马逊上搜了“airbrush kit”（喷笔套装），然后买了最显眼的那款吗？
cues.en: Did I just search on Amazon for “airbrush kit” and buy the most obvious one?

cues.zh: 没错！
cues.en: Yep!

cues.zh: 我真的会用喷笔吗？
cues.en: Do I really know how to use an airbrush?

cues.zh: 不会！
cues.en: Nope!

cues.zh: 这拦得住我吗？
cues.en: Did that stop me?

cues.zh: 不会！
cues.en: Nope!

cues.zh: 不过，有了喷笔只是问题的一部分。
cues.en: But having the airbrush is only one part of the problem.

cues.zh: 另一部分是怎么固定灯串，好让喷笔派上用场。
cues.en: The other was how to hold the lights to make airbrushing possible.

cues.zh: 正如我之前提过的，
cues.en: Now, as I’ve discussed previously,

cues.zh: 现在市面上那些配色，我很多都不喜欢。
cues.en: I really don’t care for many of the color combinations on offer today.

cues.zh: 我偏爱简单的四色组合：红、绿、蓝、黄。
cues.en: My preference is a simple four-color palette of red, green, blue, and yellow.

cues.zh: 黄色也可以换成琥珀色或橙色，
cues.en: I will accept amber or orange in place of yellow,

cues.zh: 但青绿色、紫色和粉色绝对不行，因为那是复活节的颜色，而复活节还早着呢。
cues.en: but teals and purples and pinks are completely unacceptable because those are Easter colors and that comes later.

cues.zh: 这些颜色不该出现在圣诞灯串里！
cues.en: Those colors do not belong in Christmas light sets!

cues.zh: 明白了吗？
cues.en: Capiche?

cues.zh: 运气不错，我想要的这四种颜色刚好有一套透明喷笔漆。
cues.en: As luck would have it, the very four colors I wanted were available in a set of transparent airbrush paint.

cues.zh: 我买了新颜料，以防旧的变质，而且那瓶黄色的两年前就开始分层了，现在肯定更糟。
cues.en: I bought new paint just in case the old paint was going bad, and that yellow bottle was already separating two years ago so it’s much worse now.

cues.zh: 要是出于某种原因我改主意想换个颜色，
cues.en: And if for whatever reason I were to change my mind about color preferences,

cues.zh: 也可以把这些三原色混合，调出不同的颜色。
cues.en: different colors could be made by mixing these primary colors together.

cues.zh: 不信去问你的幼儿园老师！
cues.en: Just ask your kindergarten teacher!

cues.zh: 所以，既然确定要给一串 100 颗的小彩灯喷漆，
cues.en: So, knowing that I’d be spraying a strand of one hundred mini lights

cues.zh: 并采用我那“绝对正确”的红黄绿蓝配色偏好，
cues.en: in my objectively correct preference of red, yellow, green, and blue,

cues.zh: 我就从一个 Amazon 纸箱上拆了块备用硬纸板，
cues.en: I took a spare piece of cardboard from one of those Amazon boxes

cues.zh: 用单孔打孔机沿着边缘打了 26 个孔。
cues.en: and used a single hole punch to make 26 holes along its edge.

cues.zh: 然后我用胶带封住了一个，因为我只需要 25 个。
cues.en: Then I taped over one of them because I only needed 25.

cues.zh: 接着我小心翼翼地把每隔三颗的第四颗灯泡穿过这些孔，
cues.en: And I meticulously poked every fourth light through those holes

cues.zh: 再用胶带把一些打印纸粘在纸板边缘，防止漆雾喷到其它灯泡上。
cues.en: and then taped some printer paper to the edges of the piece of cardboard to protect the rest of the set from overspray.

cues.zh: 然后我从喷笔套装里挑了这把重力式喷笔，感觉用它应该能行，
cues.en: Then I picked this gravity-fed airbrush from my airbrush kit because that would probably work,

cues.zh: 摇匀蓝色颜料瓶，往料杯里倒了点颜料，
cues.en: shook up the blue paint bottle, put some paint in the cup,

cues.zh: 直接开干。
cues.en: and went at it.

cues.zh: 天哪，居然真成功了！
cues.en: And by golly, it worked!

cues.zh: 效果相当棒！
cues.en: It worked greatly!

cues.zh: 这蓝色调得简直完美，
cues.en: The blue paint was actually a perfect color,

cues.zh: 用喷笔喷涂毫不费力，
cues.en: the airbrush made applying it nearly effortless,

cues.zh: 喷了两层之后，完全达到了我想要的效果。
cues.en: and after a couple of coats it was exactly what I was looking for.

cues.zh: 当然，剩下的就是等它晾干，
cues.en: Of course the only thing left to do was let it dry,

cues.zh: 洗干净喷笔，
cues.en: clean out the airbrush,

cues.zh: 再把喷成蓝色的灯泡全拔出来，塞进另外四分之一的灯泡准备喷下一种颜色。
cues.en: then pull out all the now blue bulbs and shove another quarter of them through the holes to prepare for the next color.

cues.zh: 然后重复这个过程。
cues.en: Then repeat.

cues.zh: 虽然这活儿还是挺折腾人的，
cues.en: This was still a pretty fiddly process,

cues.zh: 但绝对是我试过所有方法里最省事的一个了。
cues.en: but it’s definitely the least fiddly of any I’ve tried.

cues.zh: 其实最麻烦的地方，还是在一边理线、收线又免不了重新缠线的同时，还得伺候好那个固定灯泡的架子。
cues.en: In fact the primary fiddle factor was dealing with the light-holding rig while untangling and wrangling and retangling the rest of the strand.

cues.zh: 如果让我重做一次，
cues.en: If I were to do this again,

cues.zh: 我会想办法更好地固定它们。
cues.en: I would try to find a better way to hold them.

cues.zh: 也许用一大块纸板，拿台钻打上孔之类的，一次能处理五股——
cues.en: Maybe a large piece of cardboard with holes made by a drill press or something could tackle five strands at a time -

cues.zh: 不过怎么把它们排列整齐倒是个大问题。
cues.en: though how to keep them organized would be quite the question.

cues.zh: 最终效果虽然挺不错，但还是暴露出了一些瑕疵。
cues.en: And the end results, while pretty great, still reveal a few flaws.

cues.zh: 比如，我忘了上次用这些颜料时，黄色非常偏荧光黄，
cues.en: For one, I had forgotten that the last time I used these paints the yellow was very much a highlighter yellow

cues.zh: 加一点红色调暖会好很多。
cues.en: and it benefitted from adding a bit of red to warm it up.

cues.zh: 我本该再这么调的。
cues.en: I should have done that again.

cues.zh: 这红色也不太透明——有意思的是，上次用另一个牌子的透明模型漆时我也发现了同样的问题，
cues.en: This red is also not quite transparent - interestingly I found the same thing last time with this different brand of transparent model paint

cues.zh: 所以我猜这是红色颜料本身的固有问题。
cues.en: so my guess is it’s an inherent issue with red pigmenting.

cues.zh: 还有一点要考虑的是，这种涂料似乎能从热处理中受益。
cues.en: Another thing to consider is that apparently this paint benefits from heat treatment.

cues.zh: 至于能否安全操作而不熔化塑料帽，我就不知道了。
cues.en: Whether that can be safely done without melting the plastic caps I don’t know.

cues.zh: 我没试过，也不打算试。
cues.en: I didn’t try and I’m not going to.

cues.zh: 今年，我打算把这串灯放到室外，让它暴露在南方的阳光和
cues.en: This year, I am going to actually put this strand outside where it will be exposed both to the Southern sun and the

cues.zh: 我们这儿那美得冒泡的天气里。
cues.en: just lovely weather we get around here.

cues.zh: 我会在第二个频道汇报它的耐久性——如果还没订阅的话，不妨去订阅一下。
cues.en: I’ll report back on its durability on the second channel - so maybe subscribe there if you haven’t.

cues.zh: 我也会试着发一条社区帖子。
cues.en: I’ll try to do one of those community posts too.

cues.zh: 现在，你可能会问，
cues.en: Now, you might ask,

cues.zh: “你为什么要这样折腾自己？”我的回答会是
cues.en: “why are you doing this to yourself?” and my response would be

cues.zh: “这是个好问题。”
cues.en: “that’s an excellent question.”

cues.zh: 总的来说，我只是想证明这是可行的！
cues.en: Broadly, I just want to show that this can be done!

cues.zh: 是的，也许我只是个跟不上时代的倔老头，
cues.en: Yes, maybe I’m just a curmudgeon who’s out of touch,

cues.zh: 但我真的很想在节日期间用上LED多彩灯饰，因为白炽灯组耗电量简直离谱！
cues.en: but I really would like to use LED multicolored lighting ‘round the holidays because incandescent light sets use a stupid amount of power!

cues.zh: 去年 12 月我的电费直接翻了一倍，就因为我挂了两串 C9 灯泡
cues.en: Last year my power bill doubled for the month of December merely because I had two C9 sets

cues.zh: 外加大概六条闪烁灯带，每晚开 8 个小时。
cues.en: and I wanna say six runs of twinkling lights running for 8 hours a night.

cues.zh: 这太离谱了，特别是考虑到我自己还开着一辆电动车！
cues.en: That’s ridiculous, especially considering I have an electric car!

cues.zh: 但现在市面上所有的五彩灯串，看起来还是像廉价电竞外设那种花哨光效，
cues.en: But all the multicolored strands on the market today still look like gamer vomit

cues.zh: 无论平时还是过节，我都绝不想把家里弄成这副德行，尤其是过节的时候！
cues.en: and that’s just not something I want all over my home at any time but especially not the holidays!

cues.zh: 不过英国那边传来了一个好消息！
cues.en: And there’s good news out of the UK!

cues.zh: 有位观众联系了我，给我发了一款灯串的照片，完全就是我想要的。
cues.en: A viewer got in touch and sent me pictures of a light strand that is EXACTLY what I’m asking for.

cues.zh: 它跟这串非常像，但里面的二极管都是柔和漂亮的暖白光，
cues.en: It’s a set very much like this one but where the diodes are all a nice warm white

cues.zh: 颜色则完全来自决定仿真灯泡外形的塑料外壳。
cues.en: and its coloring comes from the plastic caps that define the shape of the pseudo-bulb.

cues.zh: 在这种情况下，我觉得色彩可能没达到我期望的浓度——
cues.en: In this case, I think the coloring might not be quite as strong as I’d like -

cues.zh: 我担心这更偏向柔和的马卡龙色系，而不是我想要的那种浓郁色彩。
cues.en: I worry this is more of a pastel color theme than the rich colors I’m looking for.

cues.zh: 但这证明了，只要有人肯尝试，是完全能做出来的。
cues.en: But it shows somebody could make this if they just tried.

cues.zh: 所以，你们当中负责向海外代工厂采购那些彩灯的朋友，
cues.en: So, one of you in charge of ordering all those lights from whatever factories overseas make them,

cues.zh: 或许可以试着往这个方向引导一下。
cues.en: maybe try and steer things in this direction.

cues.zh: 还有 Tru-Tone 的朋友们——你们完全可以挑起这个大梁！
cues.en: And to the folks at Tru-Tone - you could be those people!

cues.zh: 要是能直接买到这些，我真会高兴疯了，
cues.en: I will be incredibly happy if I can just... buy these

cues.zh: 就不用为了勉强还原我想要的效果，去折腾这些麻烦事了。
cues.en: and not go through this nonsense just to get some semblance of the things I’m looking for.

cues.zh: 如果真有人能做出来，让我也能在店里和其他节日装饰一起随手买到……
cues.en: And if somebody finally manages to make this a thing I can get in stores with all the other holiday stuff...

cues.zh: 你们大家最好都给我去买！好吗？
cues.en: you all had better buy them! Ok?

cues.zh: 我可不想发现，原来大家其实更喜欢那种难看的蓝绿色激光束灯！
cues.en: I don’t want to find out that the gross blue-green laser beam lights are actually what you people want!

cues.zh: 我会非常失望的，而且我保证你会没完没了地听我念叨。
cues.en: I will be so disappointed and you’ll never hear the end of it, I promise.

cues.zh: 节日快乐！
cues.en: Happy holidays!

cues.zh: ♫ 意想不到的圣诞爵士乐 ♫
cues.en: ♫ Unexpectedly Christmas Jazz ♫

cues.zh: 但是，多彩的[ ] LED
cues.en: But, multicolored [ ] LED

cues.zh: 我应该把它们准备好来演示。
cues.en: I should have them ready to demonstrate.

cues.zh: 现代的LED圣诞灯串通常会……
cues.en: Modern LED christmas light sets usually make it…

cues.zh: 刚才怎么回事？
cues.en: what happened there?

cues.zh: 你被什么绊住了，你这讨厌的东西？
cues.en: What did you get caught on, you terrible thing?

cues.zh: ……模拟出相对的亮度比例会是……
cues.en: …mimicked the relative brightness ratios would be…

cues.zh: 糟糕。
cues.en: crap.

cues.zh: 我无缘无故改了个时态[清嗓子]
cues.en: I changed the tense of something for no reason [clears throat]

cues.zh: 不同颜色可以通过混合这些原色来产生。
cues.en: Different colors could be made by mixing these primary colors together.

cues.zh: 就问你的[噗！]
cues.en: Justk ask your [ppfttah!]

cues.zh: 不同颜色可以通过混合这些原色来产生。
cues.en: Different colors could be made by mixing these primary colors together.

cues.zh: 就问你的那个……
cues.en: Just ask your tche…

cues.zh: 我为什么卡在这个词上了？
cues.en: why am I struggling with that?

cues.zh: 现在看看那些漂亮的闪烁灯光。
cues.en: Now look at all those pretty twinkling lights.

cues.zh: 令人崩溃的是，我觉得Menards已经不卖它们了。
cues.en: Devastatingly, I think Menards has discontinued them.

cues.zh: 现在看来，我这几年囤了这么多，倒也不觉得亏了。
cues.en: Now I don't feel so bad about hoarding them these last few years.
